name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina. The project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of approximately 248 million ounces of silver and 2.54 million ounces of gold (454 Moz silver equivalent). The company is advancing toward a Definitive Feasibility Study with a final investment decision targeted for 2026.
